held.why: carried from C8: the mist paragraph states specific changes and CreatureState records no current form; the base and bat profiles are not held

held.case: a trait or condition that changes a creature's check (Keen Senses, Sunlight Sensitivity, Disadvantage from a condition)
held.why: not part of the Skills entry. Typed traits are existing creature_roll_modifier facts and conditions existing condition facts; contest execution must apply or refuse them as it does any contributor. This candidate types the printed entry only.

held.case: a creature under Polymorph, Shapechange or another form-changing effect, or a summoned form not in the roster
held.why: general spell execution is excluded; refuses as an unexecuted active effect (as in C8)

S1.claim: A creature profile whose stat block prints no Skills entry is proficient in no skill: its complete Skills list is empty. An empty list is a positive source statement, distinct from a missing fact.
S1.claim_span: the native stage claims the span holding the stat block's details lines (Senses/Languages/CR), where the entry would appear; the raw stage lists the component's existing claim spans, as C8 did

evidence.quote: If a monster lacks those details, entries for them don't appear.
The Skills entry specifies a monster's skill proficiencies, if any.
_Skills._ This entry lists the monster's skill proficiencies, if any.

S2.basis: the same classification C8 accepted for the creature type (I2)
S2.claim: A Shape-Shift keeping game statistics the same in each form keeps the Skills entry; the bat form likewise. The mist form is held.

S3.basis: the diagnostic below shows printed totals that exceed modifier + PB (for example doubled PB); decomposing them would invent a cause the stat block does not state
S3.claim: A printed skill bonus is the complete check bonus for that skill. It is recorded as printed and never decomposed into ability modifier, Proficiency Bonus or Expertise, and nothing is re-added.

evidence.quote: A skill bonus is the sum of a monster's relevant ability modifier and its Proficiency Bonus. Other modifiers might apply.
